reference: She moved to the drum kit while the camera was still rolling.
sk: K bicím prešla, kým kamera ešte bežala.
cz: K bicím přešla, zatímco kamera ještě běžela.
acceptable: She {moved|went|walked|switched} {to|over to} the {drum kit|drums} {while|as} the camera was still {rolling|running|recording}.
{While|As} the camera was still {rolling|running|recording}, she {moved|went|walked|switched} {to|over to} the {drum kit|drums}.

mistakes.text: She was moving to the {drum kit|drums} while the camera was still rolling.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Prechod k bicím je krátky, dokončený dej, preto Past Simple: „moved“, nie „was moving“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Přechod k bicím je krátký, dokončený děj, proto Past Simple: „moved“, ne „was moving“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Moving to the drums is a short, completed action, so use Past Simple: “moved”, not “was moving”.

mistakes.text: She moved to the {drum kit|drums} while the camera still rolled.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Dej, ktorý stále prebiehal, vyjadruje Past Continuous: „was still rolling“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Děj, který stále probíhal, vyjadřuje Past Continuous: „was still rolling“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The action still going on needs Past Continuous: “was still rolling”.

mistakes.text: She has moved to the {drum kit|drums} while the camera was still rolling.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Príbeh je v minulosti, preto Past Simple „moved“, nie Present Perfect „has moved“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Příběh je v minulosti, proto Past Simple „moved“, ne Present Perfect „has moved“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The story is in the past, so use Past Simple “moved”, not Present Perfect “has moved”.

mistakes.text: She {moved|went} to drums while the camera was still rolling.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Chýba člen: „to the drums“ alebo „to the drum kit“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Chybí člen: „to the drums“ nebo „to the drum kit“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The article is missing: “to the drums” or “to the drum kit”.

mistakes.text: She moved to the {drum kit|drums} while the camera still was rolling.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Slovká ako „still“ stoja zvyčajne až za „was“: „was still rolling“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Slova jako „still“ stojí obvykle až za „was“: „was still rolling“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Words like “still” usually go after “was”: “was still rolling”.

source_issues: SK/CZ 'bicie/bicí' = drums; 'the drums' accepted alongside 'the drum kit'.
